related.title: Cadia 地下金銅礦
related.why: 可遷移物料守恆、代表取樣及環境證據；物相、搬運路徑與回收方法需重設。
related.whyEn: Material balance, representative sampling and environmental evidence transfer while phases, handling paths and recovery methods must be respecified.
related.transfer: 可遷移物料守恆、代表取樣及環境證據；物相、搬運路徑與回收方法需重設。
related.transferEn: Material balance, representative sampling and environmental evidence transfer while phases, handling paths and recovery methods must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課針對露天礦、自治搬運與物料回收；Cadia 地下金銅礦改以panel caving、地下支援與長期礦水為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on surface mining, autonomous haulage and material recovery; Cadia underground gold/copper mine centers on panel caving, underground support and long-term mine water, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照金銅grade分佈與地下grade與取樣，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到Cadia 地下金銅礦，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以礦水尾礦與覆育為起點，設計一項能區分「露天礦、自治搬運與物料回收」與「panel caving、地下支援與長期礦水」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare gold/copper grades with underground grades/sampling and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Cadia underground gold/copper mine, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from mine water/tailings/rehabilitation and propose an observation distinguishing surface mining, autonomous haulage and material recovery from panel caving, underground support and long-term mine water, including uncertainty.

related.title: Kibali 大型金礦工程
related.why: 可遷移物料守恆、代表取樣及環境證據；物相、搬運路徑與回收方法需重設。
related.whyEn: Material balance, representative sampling and environmental evidence transfer while phases, handling paths and recovery methods must be respecified.
related.transfer: 可遷移物料守恆、代表取樣及環境證據；物相、搬運路徑與回收方法需重設。
related.transferEn: Material balance, representative sampling and environmental evidence transfer while phases, handling paths and recovery methods must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課針對露天礦、自治搬運與物料回收；Kibali 大型金礦工程改以多路徑採礦、支援電力與回收證據為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on surface mining, autonomous haulage and material recovery; Kibali large gold-mining engineering centers on multiple mining routes, support power and recovery evidence, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照金銅grade分佈與Kibali資源grade，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到Kibali 大型金礦工程，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以礦水尾礦與覆育為起點，設計一項能區分「露天礦、自治搬運與物料回收」與「多路徑採礦、支援電力與回收證據」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare gold/copper grades with kibali resource grades and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Kibali large gold-mining engineering, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from mine water/tailings/rehabilitation and propose an observation distinguishing surface mining, autonomous haulage and material recovery from multiple mining routes, support power and recovery evidence, including uncertainty.

history.title: Boddington 自動化金銅礦
history.text: Boddington 自動化金銅礦的公開資料展示露天礦、自治搬運與物料回收的工程脈絡；本課以不同功能層與可驗證輸出重建教學案例，不宣稱取得任何專有製造流程。
history.textEn: Public sources for Boddington automated gold/copper mine illustrate surface mining, autonomous haulage and material recovery. The course reconstructs functional layers and verifiable outputs educationally without proprietary manufacturing access.

history.title: 從工程故事到可檢查模型

history.text: 本課將露天礦、自治搬運與物料回收改寫為原創離線分析題；不複製來源的製造圖、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns surface mining, autonomous haulage and material recovery into original offline analysis exercises without copying manufacturing drawings, video transcripts or field procedures.
